scripts.label: Positional unsupported alternative
scripts.text: Another move would have left a piece unguarded. That doesn't necessarily mean it could be won.

scripts.label: Positional king flight alternative
scripts.text: Another move would have opened a new square for the king to move to. Compare the boards to see what would clear the way.

scripts.label: Positional castling alternative
scripts.text: The alternative was to castle. It would have moved both the king and the rook.

scripts.label: Positional bishop pair alternative
scripts.text: Another move would have captured a bishop and broken up the opposing bishop pair.

scripts.label: Positional doubled alternative
scripts.text: Another move would have left doubled pawns: pawns of the same color sharing a file.

scripts.label: Allowed mate
scripts.text: This move allows a forced checkmate. Let's look at how the attack breaks through the defense.

scripts.label: Missed mate
scripts.text: There was a forced checkmate available, but this move lets it go. Look back for the finish.

scripts.label: Immediate capture
scripts.text: The other side can capture right away. Look at the reply to see what can be taken.

scripts.label: Reply check
scripts.text: The strongest reply gives check, so answering that threat has to come first.

scripts.label: Stronger alternative
scripts.text: There's a move the engine prefers here. Try it on the board and compare the replies.

scripts.label: Evaluation loss
scripts.text: The engine finds this move weaker than the best option. Look at the reply to see what changed.

scripts.label: Best supported choice
scripts.text: A strong choice. It holds up against the engine's replies.

scripts.label: Good choice
scripts.text: A sound move, even though the engine prefers another. It keeps much of what the position had to offer.

scripts.label: Chance missed
scripts.text: The opponent's last move offered an opportunity, but this lets it pass. Look back for a better way to respond.

scripts.label: Srs summary engine accepted
scripts.text: This move is accepted for this exercise. There isn't a clear tactical explanation in the moves shown.

scripts.label: Srs summary engine rejected
scripts.text: This move isn't accepted for this exercise. The moves shown don't give a clear tactical reason.

scripts.label: Explanation frame original
scripts.text: Here is the position we're starting from, before the moves we're examining.

scripts.label: Explanation frame quiet move ordinary
scripts.text: Here is the next move to examine.

scripts.label: Explanation frame quiet move check
scripts.text: This move gives check. The threat to the king must be answered.

scripts.label: Explanation frame quiet move escape
scripts.text: This gets the king out of check.
